chapter: Chicago: Henderson, Tatum and Roy Eldridge, then New York and the army
title: Teaching Tiny Grimes for Tatum while in the army
summary: On furlough in 1942 Collins taught Tiny Grimes chords and voicings for Tatum's trio, and says four army years kept him off the scene.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: But in the mean time Art had approached me about joining him with the trio, but you know, obviously I couldn't take the job because I had to go into the army, so I came back to New York on furlough and I went to see Art. He was working at this time at another club now, the Three Deuces, farther down the street. And this was in 1942. And Tiny Grimes was playing with him. And Art would tell me, John, please go over there and teach Tiny "Body and Soul", but Tiny was -- he just loved Charlie Christian, this is all he knew was Charlie Christian. He didn't know anything about chords or

voicings or anything, so I would show him these tunes. Every time I would go to New York I would have to do this, you know, and it would kill me because I wanted to be out of the army. But it seemed, you know -- you wonder why I never got more acclaim.

Now, this is why -- as fate would have it, I was just in the wrong place at the -- you know, when things were happening -- when something would happen that I would just be off the scene, you know. I spent four years in the army, you know. This is right at the time when I should have been doing good things, you know.
